verbosity.description: Verbosity level for pixiewps output. 1 is quietest, 3 is most verbose.

mode.description: Comma-separated list of attack modes. 1 (RT/MT/CL), 2 (eCos simple), 3 (RTL819x), 4 (eCos simplest), 5 (eCos Knuth).

start_date.description: Starting date for mode 3 attacks (MM/YYYY or YYYY). Defaults to Unix epoch if not set.

end_date.description: Ending date for mode 3 attacks (MM/YYYY or YYYY). Defaults to max time if not set.

input_args.description: List of key-value pairs for required and optional input arguments like --pke, --pkr, --e-hash1, etc.

input_args.items.description: Each item in the input_args list is a key-value pair representing a pixiewps command line argument flag and its value.

input_args.items.value.description: The value for the argument flag.

use_small_dh.description: Enable small Diffie-Hellman keys (deprecated option, must match Reaver config if used).

m7_enc.description: Encrypted settings from M7 for Mode 3 to recover WPA-PSK.

m5_enc.description: Encrypted settings from M5 for Mode 3 to recover secret nonce 1 (used with m7_enc).

force_backward.description: If true, pixiewps starts from current time and goes backwards (implies --force logic in date handling).
